versions.content: {DRAFT} When a Null pointer has been passed to a UdpNm service, the called function shall not be executed and it shall return E_NOT_OK to the calling function if applicable. If development error detection is enabled (UdpNmDevErrorDetect is set to TRUE) the corres ponding error UDPNM_E_PARAM_POINTER shall be reported to DET.
